notes: Endpoints: the spec is committed as fragments of the paths object (api/v4/source/*.yaml, assembled by the repo's own build), unioned here into 608 operations under /api/v4; scope server/channels/api4/. Every route is registered on a gorilla subrouter kept in a struct field built in api.go — api.BaseRoutes.Users = api.BaseRoutes.APIRoot.PathPrefix("/users").Subrouter(), APIRoot = Router.PathPrefix(model.APIURLSuffix) — and used from another file: api.BaseRoutes.Users.Handle("/known", h).Methods(http.MethodGet). The method and the relative path come out right; the prefix never does, and the roots Handle("", ...) are dropped (prefix-other-file, all 607). The e2e webhook test server (e2e-tests/cypress) registers routes outside test patterns (test-app-folder). Calls (sample only): the webapp and e2e helpers call `${Client4.getBaseRoute()}/...`, whose /api/v4 lives in the client class (prefix-in-client-wrapper) or in a route helper (url-from-helper); url.JoinPath(serverURL, "version") keeps the variable base as a placeholder (url-object-builder). CI scripts and external services are right. The webapp itself calls through Client4 (doFetch with this.getXRoute()), not measured.
